result.question: What happened to the young man who fell out of the window while Paul was speaking?

assessments.reason: Verse 20:9 explicitly says he “fell from the third story and was picked up dead,” which answers what happened immediately after the fall.
Verse 20:10 reports Paul saying, “He is still alive!” after embracing him, which also answers what happened depending on the time frame intended.

result.reason: The passage states both that he was picked up dead and, after Paul embraced him, that he was still alive, so either outcome can answer the question depending on timing.
